_doc: Machine-readable funding registry, created by bootstrap/bootstrap.py as funding/registry.json. funding/verify.py reads it weekly (.github/workflows/funding-maintenance.yml) and funding/file_issues.py files issues for stale, expiring or broken entries. Update last_verified only after reading the primary source. status: verified = read at the primary source on last_verified; secondary = third-party summary; unverified = from memory or unreachable.
